source_findings.finding: Blank --entrypoint is a distinct argv token before image. Caller command_argv follows image unchanged. Process_eio passes the list into process spawning without a shell/string round trip. The empty token is retained.

Grep accepts backend exits 0/1/2, but classifies only 0/1 as Completed. Exit127 is not admitted by backend, becomes an Error, then Keeper_tool_execution.failure Runtime_failure. Exit1 remains Completed with structured ok=true and empty matches when stdout empty.

Actual tool dispatch preserves Failed class through Tool_result.make_err, observer/registry failure handling and returned dispatch_result. Tool_result serialization retains failure_class/disposition/message. No successful empty-search coercion occurs in this traced failure branch. This is source evidence, not an executed model-wire assertion.

The two registered tests enter real Keeper_workspace_read_ops.try_handle_with_outcome with Docker-profile metadata, catalogued image and existing sandbox root. Only Docker executable is replaced by the existing fixture. Modeled image entrypoint intercept returns1 unless exact separate empty override is present; then returns declared program exit127 or1. On old product code the missing-program case is classified Completed and its assertion fails; fixed code returns typed Runtime_failure. Positive test protects real no-match acceptance.

Assertions inspect returned execution after handler completion. Existing Fun.protect fixture restoration/cleanup does not swallow callback assertion failures. New tests reuse an already-used public module and are registered in the existing native suite listed by test/dune.

The product change is one argv insertion. Mount/read-only/network-none/user/capability/seccomp/secret handling and Remote/Attached/Turn_runtime branches are unchanged. Clearing a setup entrypoint intentionally enforces the existing documented caller-program contract. No new authority, root, timeout or exit-code policy is introduced.
Documentation describes executable ownership and default-entrypoint clearing. No public function signature or typed result API changes.

validation.description: Entire exact committed three-file diff and direct outcome/transport/test setup consumers read.
Exact HEAD and direct parent verified, complete raw diff identity computed locally from immutable committed objects.

limitations: No OCaml compilation, native tests, Docker execution, API/provider request, CI query or approval publication was performed for this review.
New tests model Docker entrypoint interception/program outcomes. They do not execute real Docker or rg, establish image package availability, or prove provider-visible serialized error delivery.

The fake script checks empty entrypoint placement before image and supplies an exit; it does not independently validate the generated rg executable/arguments. The production handler constructs rg in source; existing bare-command argv coverage is adjacent and unchanged.
No claim is made for arbitrary container image behavior, other backends, runtime installation, deployment, model success or full-stack acceptance.
Candidate checkout has unrelated untracked author changelog/evidence at final identity read; they are excluded from this committed source review.
